caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher with a wide, rounded body and a narrow neck that flares out at the top into a spout and handle. The pitcher is primarily white with decorative elements in gold and blue. There is a gold band around the base and the rim, as well as an intricate gold pattern encircling the neck just below the rim. On the body of the pitcher, there is a gold wreath surrounding a small floral motif, with a blue ribbon at the bottom of the wreath. The background is plain and unadorned, highlighting the pitcher as the central subject of the composition.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
